C08-M08-L07-F1.title: The tabletop exercise lifecycle
C08-M08-L07-F1.caption: Seven steps from evaluable objectives to an owned improvement plan, with the improvements feeding the next exercise.
C08-M08-L07-F1.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of seven steps: 1 Set objectives, 2 Scope + participants, 3 Scenario + MSEL, 4 Roles + ground rules, 5 Facilitate, 6 Hotwash, 7 AAR + improvement plan. A dashed feedback arrow runs from step 7 back to step 1, labelled improvement actions are tested in the next exercise.

steps.label: 5 Facilitate
steps.sub: release injects, ask by role, log decisions

steps.label: 7 AAR + improvement plan
steps.sub: each gap gets an owner and a date

loop.label: improvement actions are tested in the next exercise

C08-M08-L07-F1.note: Design happens in steps 1-4, before players see anything; value is only realised at step 7.
